preface.p: Building Energy Efficiency Disclosure Amendment Act 2015
An Act to amend the Building Energy Efficiency Disclosure Act 2010, and for related purposes
Building Energy Efficiency Disclosure Amendment Act 2015
An Act to amend the Building Energy Efficiency Disclosure Act 2010, and for related purposes

content.p: This Act may be cited as the Building Energy Efficiency Disclosure Amendment Act 2015.
This Act commences on 1 July 2015.

Legislation that is specified in a Schedule to this Act is amended or repealed as set out in the applicable items in the Schedule concerned, and any other item in a Schedule to this Act has effect according to its terms.

Repeal the section, substitute:
In this Act:
issue day, in relation to a building energy efficiency certificate for a building or an area of a building, means the day on which the certificate is issued under subsection 13A(1).
start day, in relation to a building energy efficiency certificate for a building or an area of a building, means:
the issue day for the certificate; or
a later day specified in the certificate as the start day.
A person may apply to an issuing authority for a building energy efficiency certificate for a building or an area of a building.
The application must:
be in writing, in a form approved by the Secretary; and
include the following:
an energy efficiency rating for the building (or the building in which the area is located);
a lighting energy efficiency assessment for the building or the area;
the start day the person seeks; and
meet any other requirements determined by the Secretary under subsection (6).
The energy efficiency rating must satisfy one of the following conditions:
the rating was worked out by an accredited assessor by applying the assessment methods and standards determined under section 21;
an auditing authority:
provided or approved the rating; and
is satisfied that the rating was worked out by applying the assessment methods and standards determined under section 21.
The lighting energy efficiency assessment must satisfy one of the following conditions:
the assessment was performed by an accredited assessor by applying the assessment methods and standards determined under section 21;
an auditing authority:
provided or approved the assessment; and
is satisfied that the assessment was performed by applying the assessment methods and standards determined under section 21.
The Secretary may, by legislative instrument, make a determination for the purposes of paragraph (3)(c).
Note: For who is an issuing authority, see section 71A.
An issuing authority may, on application under section 13, issue a building energy efficiency certificate for a building or an area of a building if the issuing authority is satisfied that:
the application meets the requirements of subsections 13(3), (4) and (5); and
the energy efficiency rating is appropriate for the building (or the building in which the area is located), applying the methods and standards determined under section 21; and
the lighting energy efficiency assessment is appropriate for the building or the area, applying the methods and standards determined under section 21.
The certificate must set out the following:
the energy efficiency rating for the building (or the building in which the area is located);
the lighting energy efficiency assessment for the building or the area;
the start day for the certificate (which may be different from the start day sought by the applicant);
the period for which the certificate is current;
any other information determined by the Secretary under subsection (4).
For paragraph (2)(d), the period set out in the certificate must be a period of no more than 12 months beginning on the start day set out in the certificate.
The Secretary may, by legislative instrument, make a determination for the purposes of paragraph (2)(e).

Repeal the section, substitute:
Application for an exemption
A person may apply to the Secretary for a building or an area of a building to be exempt from the operation of section 11, 12 or 15.
The application must:
be in writing in a form approved by the Secretary; and
include information of a kind prescribed by regulation; and
be accompanied by the fee (if any) prescribed by regulation.
Granting an exemption
The Secretary may grant the exemption:
if the Secretary is satisfied that the building or the area is used for police or security operations; or
if the Secretary is satisfied that the building or the area is non-assessable (see subsections (7) and (8)); or
in circumstances prescribed by regulation for the purposes of this paragraph.
The Secretary must give the applicant written notice of the Secretary’s decision under subsection (3).
Varying or revoking an exemption
The Secretary may vary or revoke an exemption by giving notice in writing to:
the applicant; and
any other person whose interest in the building or the area is registered with a land titles office (however described).
(6) Subsection (5) does not limit subsection 33(3) of the Acts Interpretation Act 1901.
Meaning of non-assessable

(7) A building is non-assessable if it is not possible to work out an energy efficiency rating for the building, or perform a lighting energy efficiency assessment for the building, because of the characteristics of the building.

(8) An area of a building is non-assessable if it is not possible to work out an energy efficiency rating for the building in which the area is located, or perform a lighting energy efficiency assessment for the area, because of the characteristics of the building or the area.
A building or an area of a building is exempt from the operation of section 11, 12 or 15 if circumstances specified in a determination under paragraph 21(1)(d) apply to the building or the area.

An instrument under subsection (1) is not a legislative instrument.
The amendments of the Building Energy Efficiency Disclosure Act 2010 made by Part 1 of this Schedule apply in relation to the following:
an offer to enter into a contract made on or after the commencement of this Schedule;
an invitation to make such an offer made or continued on or after the commencement of this Schedule;
an application for a building energy efficiency certificate made under section 13 of that Act on or after the commencement of this Schedule, and the issue of a certificate on such an application;
a building energy efficiency certificate issued as mentioned in paragraph (c);

in the case of the amendment of section 14 of that Act (the Building Energy Efficiency Register)—a building energy efficiency certificate, or an exemption under section 17, issued or granted before, on or after the commencement this Schedule;
an application for an exemption made under section 17 of that Act on or after the commencement of this Schedule, and the grant, variation or revocation of such an exemption;
an exemption granted as mentioned in paragraph (f);
the exercise of a power under section 18 of that Act (information gathering) on or after the commencement of this Schedule;
an infringement notice given to a person under section 58 of that Act on or after the commencement of this Schedule.
Note: This Schedule commences on 1 July 2015 (see section 2).

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Saving—recognition of issuing authority before commencement

content.p: Despite the repeal of section 13 of the Building Energy Efficiency Disclosure Act 2010 by Part 1 of this Schedule, an issuing authority recognised under that section immediately before the commencement of this Schedule is taken to continue to be recognised under that section on and after that time for all purposes in relation to:
considering an application for a building energy efficiency certificate made, but not determined, before that commencement; and
making a decision on such an application.
